description: This is a React-like component definition for a SearchBar UI element implemented using the Lightning JS framework. It provides a styled search input with simulated text entry and blinking caret, handling focus, input, and search submission.

methods.name: _startCaretBlink
methods.description: Starts an interval timer to toggle the visibility of the blinking caret.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input value and notifies the parent component to refresh.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatically sets the input value, used for hydration.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Triggers the search callback with the current input value.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets the component into focused state and starts caret blinking.

methods.name: unfocus
methods.description: Removes focus from the component and stops caret blinking.
